notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it, Cloudstone Curio and Inalla trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Peregrine Drake with haste.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Peregrine Drake to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
